svg.title: Arm E flow
svg.text: Arm E — defect augmentation: raise the prior odds of blobs and scratches without breaking Noise2Noise
The same field on input and target keeps
the noises independent, so the L2 optimum
is still E[x + δ | y + δ]: the network learns
that soft stains exist in flats.
Half of the windows get defects (p = 0.5).
Outcome (§7): retention of the REAL dev blemishes did not move (0.67 vs 0.68 median), no false features appeared. The shrinkage of weak features is set by the evidence in one frame
(median stain SNR 0.45), not by a prior that considers stains rare — a closed hypothesis, and a harmless option for corpora where defects really are rare in training.
